mechanical_findings.ctfe_size_of: The intrinsic reads type argument 0, calls layout_of, rejects unsized layout by span_bug, takes layout.size.bytes(), and writes Scalar::from_target_usize.
mechanical_findings.target_usize: Scalar::from_target_usize uses cx.data_layout().pointer_offset() as the scalar width.
mechanical_findings.integer_equality: binary_int_op obtains scalar integers, checks compatible type layouts (except shifts), converts to unsigned values after signed-order special cases, and the Eq arm compares l == r to return a bool.
mechanical_findings.named_const_path: THIR ExprKind::NamedConst becomes Const::Ty for type consts or MIR Const::Unevaluated otherwise; Operand::Constant evaluation calls eval_mir_constant; mir::Const::eval calls tcx.const_eval_resolve for Const::Unevaluated; the const-eval query provider evaluates the MIR body in the CTFE interpreter.
mechanical_findings.charon_type_layout: translate_layout instantiates and normalizes the item type, constructs a typing-env query input, queries tcx.layout_of, and maps sized size/alignment plus variant/discriminator details into the restricted Layout. translate_items attaches that layout under the target triple on TypeDecl.
